themes_detail.label: Street Condition Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Street condition complaints spiked to 131 THIS WEEK, a 253% increase versus the 8-week baseline average of 37.1 weekly complaints (z-score: 6.8), suggesting a sudden infrastructure failure or weather-related deterioration affecting major thoroughfares in Ridgewood/Glendale/Middle Village.
evidence: 131 street condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 37.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (253% spike)
Z-score of 6.8 indicates statistically significant anomaly
Recurring CB budget request for DEP sewer inspection/repair suggests pre-existing infrastructure vulnerabilities
reporting_angles: Ground truth: Which streets are worst affected? Interview residents about potholes, flooding, or crumbling pavement
City response: Has DOT issued emergency repair notices? Why did this spike occur in the past 7 days?

themes_detail.label: Hazardous Materials Spike
themes_detail.summary: Hazardous materials complaints jumped to 3 LAST WEEK, a 2300% increase from the 8-week baseline of 0.1 weekly complaints (z-score: 8.69), indicating potential chemical or waste exposure incidents requiring immediate investigation.
evidence: 3 hazardous materials complaints last week vs. 0.1 weekly average (2300% spike, z-score: 8.69)
No recent news coverage or Reddit discussion of chemical spills in district
371 building permits filed in past 90 days, including 9 demolitions—potential source of hazmat exposure
reporting_angles: What were the 3 hazardous materials complaints about? Request 311 case details for specifics on location and substance
Are demolition or construction sites improperly handling asbestos, lead paint, or chemical waste?

themes_detail.label: Sanitation System Breakdown
themes_detail.summary: Sanitation worker/vehicle complaints (4 last week, 700% above 8-week avg) and litter basket requests (3 last week, 700% above baseline) combined with dumpster complaints (6 three weeks ago, 700% spike) suggest systemic failures in trash collection and street cleanliness across the district.
evidence: Sanitation worker/vehicle complaints: 4 last week vs. 0.5 average (700% spike, z-score: 7.0)
Litter basket requests: 3 last week vs. 0.4 average (700% spike, z-score: 5.42)
Dumpster complaints: 6 three weeks ago vs. 0.8 average (700% spike, z-score: 6.33)
Illegal parking (6,126 complaints over 90 days) and blocked driveway complaints (2,258) may indicate dumpsters/collection vehicles blocking streets
reporting_angles: Have sanitation routes been reduced or delayed? Interview Sanitation Department about staffing and schedule changes
Visit neighborhoods to document overflowing bins, uncollected trash, and blocked sidewalks; identify which streets are most affected

themes_detail.label: Non-Emergency Police Calls Surge
themes_detail.summary: Non-emergency police matter complaints rose to 24 LAST WEEK, a 163% increase from the 9.1 weekly average (z-score: 5.9), suggesting uptick in quality-of-life, crime, or disorder incidents worth investigating for community safety trends.
evidence: 24 non-emergency police complaints last week vs. 9.1 weekly average (163% spike, z-score: 5.9)
No corroborating Reddit discussions or local news coverage of crime/safety incidents
Noise complaints (residential + commercial: 1,322 total over 90 days) may correlate with disorder-related 311 calls
reporting_angles: NYPD data: What types of non-emergency calls spiked? (trespassing, noise complaints, suspicious activity, etc.)
Community perception: Interview residents and business owners about whether they feel less safe; any visible disorder or encampments?

themes_detail.label: Wood Pile & Litter Basket Infrastructure
themes_detail.summary: Wood pile complaints (3,100% spike to 4 complaints) and litter basket complaints (2,300% spike to 3 complaints) THREE WEEKS AGO may signal either illegal dumping/construction waste or deferred street furniture maintenance in the district.
evidence: Wood pile complaints: 4 three weeks ago vs. 0.1 baseline (3100% spike, z-score: 11.72)
Litter basket complaints: 3 three weeks ago vs. 0.1 baseline (2300% spike, z-score: 8.69)
9 full demolitions filed in past 90 days—potential source of wood debris and construction waste
reporting_angles: Are demolition sites improperly storing or dumping wood debris on streets? Site visit to identify ongoing wood pile locations
Parks/sanitation infrastructure: Are litter baskets broken or overflowing? Has the city deferred maintenance on street furniture?
